trap.label: paralelismo
trap.wrong: We will not retreat. We will not surrender. We will not to give up.
trap.right: We will not retreat. We will not surrender. We will not give up.
trap.why: Em português o paralelismo é flexível; em inglês a anáfora exige a mesma estrutura sem to.

opts: We will not… We will not…

mcq.q: Which triple of verbs keeps the same form?

fix.wrong: We will not retreat, will we not surrender.
fix.right: We will not retreat; we will not surrender.

fix.wrong: They rose, they spoke, they leaving.
fix.right: They rose, they spoke, they left.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “We will not retreat. We will not ___.” (surrender)
rewrite.answer: We will not retreat. We will not surrender.
